title: Proposal command bodies and complete mutation receipts v1
description: Existing create/confirm/reject HTTP bodies and complete successes. Root is the three operation-success union; original read-only receipt queries are in proposal-original.json.
$comment: Source-only; load proposal-read.json. Runtime checks UTF-16 lengths, lone surrogates, normalization, cross-header/body equality, identity/key/fingerprint, versions/ETag/sources and transaction outcomes. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points instead of JavaScript UTF-16 units. No complete response validator is introduced into the legacy HTTP or SDK mutation paths.

text.$comment: Nonblank, no NUL/lone surrogates; other control characters are not blanket-forbidden by the existing text parser.

normalizedText.$comment: Already trimmed. Interior whitespace/control characters other than NUL remain accepted; runtime checks lone surrogates.

idempotencyKey.$comment: Legacy write validateIdempotencyKey only requires nonempty, <=255 UTF-16 units, no whitespace. It does not impose the original-query visible ASCII profile.

writeSource.description: Preserve all fields/whitespace without URI fetching or normalization. Exact type=context-item requires a positive pin; other types may omit revision or use zero. Duplicate refs are retained; differing pins for the same local ID are rejected later by binding.

createBody.description: Original HTTP JSON object. Stable key required from body or header; if both supplied they must match. Unknown fields rejected after removing idempotency_key. Classification/TTL defaults and title/model/prompt trimming form the effective draft used in the fingerprint. Generic version headers are parsed but do not condition creation and are not in its positional fingerprint.

normalizedDraft.description: Complete normalized original draft for receipt lookup. Defaults must already be present, no outer key in draft. Runtime compares canonical(raw draft) with canonical(parseCreateProposal(raw draft)); array order, content whitespace, source whitespace and optional derivation presence are preserved.

reason.description: Validate raw length then trim before fingerprint/storage.

proposal_id.description: Optional legacy ignored body field of any JSON type: route ID overwrites it. New callers should omit it; it cannot redirect or bind the path.

reviewBody.description: Confirm/reject selected by path. Positive safe expected revision from body or If-Match/If-Match-Version, and stable key from body or Idempotency-Key. Simultaneous values must agree; header alternatives cannot be expressed by this body schema alone. Raw writes allow MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, while strict original-review queries additionally require safe increment.

mutationEnvelope.description: Outer revision, etag and sole source agree with data ID/revision. Cursor is the saved event position. Outer trace is current even on replay; event/time/cursor/status/version are historical. No full suggestion content, original draft/reason or canonical event is returned. Gateway validates selected stored receipt scalars, not all cross-field or per-operation constraints.

createEnvelope.description: Successful create remains the historical proposed revision1 even when the current proposal was later reviewed. replayed=true returns the saved command result after visibility checks.

confirmEnvelope.description: Saved human approval metadata only; no source/Plane field application.

rejectEnvelope.description: Saved rejection; current visibility is required but rejection does not require unexpired proposal or fresh local sources.
